51278351.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity of human recombinant FLAG-tagged ppGalNAcT2 expressed in HEK293 cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Analysis: SPR experiments were performed using Biacore T200 (GE Healthcare, Uppsala, Sweden) to detect the binding between compounds and ppGalNAc-T2. ppGalNAc-T2 was immobilized in a Biacore CM5 sensor chip and the SPR experiments were performed in a running buffer containing 1% DMSO (PBS, pH 7.4). Indicated concentrations of compounds were injected to the surface of the sensor chip and corresponding binding spectra were recorded. The association rate (Kon), dissociation rate (Koff) and equilibrium dissociation constant (KD) was calculated using Biacore evaluation software.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. (A) SPR assay (Biacore) of the binding between ppGalNAc-T2 with UroD, EA and GA. The change of response units over time is shown. (B) and (C) Double reciprocal plots of UroD inhibiting ppGalNAc-T2. UroD exhibits a competitive relationship with EA2 peptide (Ki = 1.068 ± 0.0035 μM) but non-competitive with UDP-GalNAc (α Ki = 6.15 ± 0.014 μM). UroD was used at concentrations of 0 μM (blue), 1 μM (gray) and 2 μM (yellow). Each point on the graph represents as mean ± SD (n = 3).
original_paragraph.Table 2: The table below Figure 2A presents the calculated binding parameters: | Compound | KD (M) | Kon (1/Ms) | Koff (1/s) | |----------|--------|------------|------------| | UroD | 2.94 × 10⁻⁷ | 3532 | 1.04 × 10⁻³ | | EA | 3.71 × 10⁻⁷ | 2367 | 8.79 × 10⁻⁴ | | GA | 9.24 × 10⁻⁷ | 1454 | 1.34 × 10⁻³ |
